description: This file implements an IOSurface-based surface for macOS using OpenGL CGL, including texture binding, framebuffer creation, and format handling for IOSurfaces in the ANGLE graphics project.

classes.name: IOSurfaceSurfaceCGL
classes.description: Class implementing an IOSurface-based surface for macOS using CGL, managing IOSurface references, texture binding, and framebuffer creation.

classes.name: IOSurfaceFramebuffer
classes.description: Framebuffer class that deletes its associated texture upon destruction.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds an IOSurface as a texture using CGLTexImageIOSurface2D.

methods.name: createDefaultFramebuffer
methods.description: Creates a framebuffer with the IOSurface texture attached.

methods.name: initializeAlphaChannel
methods.description: Initializes the alpha channel of the IOSurface texture if not already initialized.

methods.name: hasEmulatedAlphaChannel
methods.description: Determines if the IOSurface format emulates an alpha channel.
